records.title: High-altitude decompression illness: case report and discussion.
records.evidence_note: The three trainees developed symptoms during the commercial flight roughly six hours after training ended. The calendar date of the course and the count of comparable trainees who also flew are unreported. The actual case profiles reached 26,000 ft. The general description mentions approximately 25,000 ft, the altitude used in the v1.7 entry.
